title: EMERALD IMPERIUM CONSTITUTION

articles.title: IDENTITY
articles.rule: Each canonical mineral species may map to one unique immutable Emerald World ID.

articles.title: ONE MINERAL, ONE WORLD
articles.rule: One canonical mineral identity maps to one Emerald World ID; layers remain separated.

articles.title: THE 4444 PRINCIPLE
articles.rule: 4444 is capacity, not registry cardinality; excess records are preserved for expansion.

articles.title: EXPANSION
articles.rule: New minerals and new slots are independent constitutional events.

articles.title: NO TRUNCATION
articles.rule: Capacity limits never justify identity deletion.

articles.title: ALPHABETICAL ORDER
articles.rule: Initial alphabetical ordering must not override immutable identity.

articles.title: IMMUTABLE IDENTITY
articles.rule: EW IDs are permanent and never recycled.

articles.title: NOMENCLATURE
articles.rule: Rename transitions preserve world identity and lineage.

articles.title: PROVENANCE
articles.rule: Canonical worlds require source authority, epoch, and source reference.

articles.title: WATERMERK
articles.rule: Each world has a Watermerk marker; Watermerk is not authority.

articles.title: HOLOGRAM
articles.rule: Hologram is an authenticity layer, not truth, authority, or sovereignty.

articles.title: IMMORTAL
articles.rule: Historical lineage remains reconstructable.

articles.title: UNCERTAINTY
articles.rule: IN_DOUBT and CONFLICTED states are preserved when certainty is unsupported.

articles.title: Z.A.N.D.
articles.rule: Determine first, never infer canonical identity from guesses.

articles.title: RELATIONSHIPS
articles.rule: Relation edges must be typed and evidence-bound.

articles.title: CITADEL
articles.rule: Citadel is context and interaction infrastructure, not mineral identity.

articles.title: ELIXERS
articles.rule: Elixers may explore and verify but may not authorize, govern, command, or claim sovereignty.

articles.title: ALLOCATION
articles.rule: Slot allocation is mutable; world identity is immutable.

articles.title: ∆ TRANSITIONS
articles.rule: Meaningful transitions require context, evidence, decision, authorization, and traceability.

articles.title: REVOKE
articles.rule: Revoke may change allocation state but never deletes world identity.

articles.title: CEFCG
articles.rule: Evidence finality states remain explicitly separated.

articles.title: NO MINERAL SOVEREIGNTY
articles.rule: No mineral-world grants political, constitutional, sovereignty, or command authority.

articles.title: PALACO SUPREMACY
articles.rule: PALACO Constitution outranks Emerald constitution, governance, policy, and action.

articles.title: EXPANSION HORIZON
articles.rule: Expansion capability is open-ended and remains under constitutional control.

articles.title: THE LIVING EMERALD
articles.rule: Evolution is allowed, but evolution must not outrank constitution.

canonical_sentence: THE EMERALD IMPERIUM SHALL NEVER BE LIMITED BY THE NUMBER OF WORLDS IT CURRENTLY HAS THE CAPACITY TO DISPLAY.
